newsitem.title: USA: Apollo rose on first day of trade.
newsitem.headline: Apollo rose on first day of trade.

text.p: Apollo International of Delaware Inc closed at eight on its first day of trading on Friday, up three.
Apollo International priced 800,000 common shares at a target price of $5 on Thursday. May Davis was lead underwriter for the deal.
The proprosed number of shares was raised for the planned initial public offering to 800,000 from 750,000 shares originally. The common shares trade under the symbol on the Nasdaq National Market.
Apollo International produces feeder protection relays.
